title: Ask the portal discover endpoint before the password

costar.context: The portal index is done. Direct sign-in reaches the portal with a JMAP session and never calls GET /api/discover. The maintainer said resume.
costar.objective: After the account name, call GET /api/discover/:email and follow the document the way the portal does.
costar.style: One plan, then the adapter and the sign-in step.
costar.response: Continue calls discover. This server returns a local /login endpoint and no client id, so the password step stays. A document with a client id redirects to its authorization endpoint.

concerns: This running server returns authorization_endpoint /login and does not set client_id_metadata_document_supported. The portal would stop with the unconfigured sentence because oauth-client-id is empty. Stopping there removes the sign-in that already works. A local login endpoint with no client id continues to the password step.
A document that names a client id, or sets client_id_metadata_document_supported, redirects. /oauth/callback does not exist yet, so this slice must not send this server down that path.
The bundle stores the OAuth values under ShippinTECH-oauth-. New storage uses shippin-oauth-.
Discovery failure uses the portal sentence, including the status and status text.
context: The portal function Ou fetches /api/discover, resolves a client id, builds a PKCE authorization URL, and redirects. The local OpenID document from handle_oidc_metadata has a relative /login authorization endpoint and no client metadata flag.
current_state: The account step checks for @ and then shows the password. The password step calls openSession. Nothing calls /api/discover.
target_design: A pure classifier reads the discovery document. No client id and a local /login endpoint means the password step. No client id and any other endpoint means the portal unconfigured sentence. A client id means the authorization redirect. The login route calls the adapter and does not put that decision in the catalog.
changes: Add the discover classifier and the GET /api/discover call.
Call it from the account step before the password step.
boundaries: Do not remove the password step for this server's local document.
Do not add the token exchange page.
Do not call a set method.
Do not build the Astro site.
The catalog login component does not fetch.

verification.name: discover-follows-the-document
verification.proves: The live local document continues to the password. A client-metadata document redirects with the portal query. An external document without a client id uses the portal unconfigured sentence. The login route calls discover and the catalog does not.

verification.name: ui-types
verification.proves: The sign-in route and the discover adapter typecheck together.
